parsed.name: HTTP任务推送器
parsed.description: 这是一个通过 HTTP 向分布式任务队列提交任务的软件组件，可按帧生成并推送处理任务，常用于显微图像或其他逐帧数据的集群处理流程。
parsed.description_en: This is a software component that submits tasks to a distributed task queue over HTTP. It can generate and push per-frame processing tasks and is typically used in cluster workflows for microscopy images or other frame-based data.

actions.description: 为新帧生成任务定义并通过 HTTP 提交到任务队列。
actions.description_en: Generate task definitions for new frames and submit them to the task queue over HTTP.

actions.description: 清理任务推送过程中使用的资源或内部状态。
actions.description_en: Clean up resources or internal state used by the task pusher.
